facts.text: On February 8, 2023, a routine Wednesday morning chapel service at Asbury University transformed into a multi-week spiritual Outpouring and student-led revival that attracted global attention.

sources.title: The Outpouring Story of Revival | Asbury University
sources.quote: On February 8, 2023, what began as a routine Wednesday Chapel service with the student body turned into a multi-week Outpouring that some have described as a revival.
